Start the levels at 10 tries at 200' - family 10 at 200 -> 12 at 224 -> 13 at 225; the skilled player (Dennis) needs at least 2.5-3 tries. Dennis: discourage block shapes; every board must contain more than 70 tiles. Retain the two-island key/ice/clock idea in fresh larger candidates.
ratingExplanation: Equal mean of two independent fixed 40-campaign family measurements; same bot and 20-try cap. Target tolerance 0.5; seed gap over 2 requires more review.
